blocks.text: QUEZON, Bukidnon — A heated argument between live-in partners ended in tragedy after a 25-year-old man allegedly shot his 24-year-old partner in the head inside their residence in Barangay Butong here early Saturday morning. Reports from the Quezon Municipal Police Station (MPS) disclosed that neighbors heard the couple arguing inside their bedroom at around 1:10 a.m., followed by crying and a single gunshot. The suspect’s father rushed to the room and attempted to restrain his son, but the suspect managed to break free and fled on foot toward a nearby sugarcane field.
